research: E06 EL0 MMU/ASID/PAuth IRQ context switching with FP/SIMD Q8,Q9 / FPCR / FPSR / TPIDR_EL0
platform: Linux x86_64 QEMU TCG ARM64, self-authored firmware
checks: real EL0 q8/q9 vector content comparison on each user iteration
real EL0 read of TPIDR_EL0/FPCR/FPSR across distinct task contexts
EL1 explicitly saves and restores chosen SIMD/TLS/FPCR/FPSR state
MMU same VA distinct ASIDs/physical pages, no broad TLB flush per switch
IRQ/SVC/permission faults and real PACIA/BLRAA/PACIASP/AUTIASP still exercised
negative tests deliberately skip FP, FPCR, FPSR, or TLS restore and detect corruption
PAuth wrong-key, executable-data and disabled-PPI negative baselines retained
clock-exact branch runs actual guest CNTFRQ=24000000 with opt-in exact counter/deadline, while other profiles explicitly read 1GHz
limitations: Selected Q8/Q9 only; not Q0..Q31, FPMR, SVE/SME or FP trap-and-lazy restore.
One vCPU runs two EL0 integer tasks, not multi-vCPU scheduler.
Three QEMU profiles share substantial source code; not three independent implementations.
No Apple binaries or live guest macOS/WindowServer; test wall time is not performance benchmark.
PAC HVC model uses research-only keys, not Apple hardware derivation.
